meta.name: blog-post
meta.description: 杂志感长文, 含 masthead、hero、figures、pull quote、作者署名

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带杂志排版的长篇图文内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要撰写并发布具有专业杂志风格的长篇文章。
copy.tagline_en: Generate long-form content with magazine-style layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write and publish long articles with professional magazine styling.

howto.what: 会生成至少600字的杂志风格长文，排版以文字为主，含报头、大标题区、插图说明、引用块和作者署名，文末附带作者简介与相关文章卡片。
howto.when: 当用户要求撰写杂志风格的博客长文，或明确调用“blog-post”模板时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于咖啡文化的杂志感长文。
say.note: 会生成含报头、引用块的完整长文。

say.text: 用blog-post模板写我的产品发布稿。
say.note: 按模板输出带作者署名及相关文章的页面。

say.text: 写一篇案例研究，要求有插图说明和引用块。

howto.what_en: Generates a magazine-style long-form article (at least 600 words) with typography-heavy layout, including masthead, hero, figures, pull quotes, author byline, and ends with author bio and related-post cards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a magazine-style blog post or explicitly invokes the 'blog-post' template.

say_en.text: Write a magazine-style long article about coffee culture.
say_en.note: Produces a full post with masthead and pull quotes.

say_en.text: Use the blog-post template for my product launch.
say_en.note: Outputs a formatted page with author bio and related posts.

say_en.text: Write a case study with figures and pull quotes.
say_en.note: Includes figure captions and a styled pull quote.
